pokedexEntries.ru: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.

pokedexEntries.sa: LATIOS will only open its heart to a TRAINER with a compassionate spirit. This POKéMON can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.

pokedexEntries.em: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

pokedexEntries.dpp: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.
